hooks.name: downshift-observe
hooks.description: Records subagent spawns for telemetry (observation-only, no rewrite)

hooks.name: downshift-advisory
hooks.description: Advises the model on agent selection (non-enforcing guidance)

action.prompt:
Before spawning this subagent, consider the task complexity:

- **Simple tasks** (searches, lookups, file reads): Use a cost-optimized agent or context-gatherer
- **Standard tasks** (refactoring, code review, writing): Use the general-purpose agent
- **Complex tasks** (architecture, security, debugging): Consider using a specialized agent

Check .kiro/agents/ for available specialized agents with appropriate model assignments.
